skips.coverageStatement: HONEST COST, stated because a count alone would hide it: on Windows the real macOS seatbelt confinement is not exercised. That covers SEC-7 sandbox conformance, the no-keychain/DEK-reach contract, and the KgEmbed/KgGenerate runtime fail-closed proofs. These are security-relevant properties that now have NO real-confinement coverage on the machine the gates run on. The structured non-darwin assertions in the same files still run, so the membrane wiring is still proven; the confinement itself is not. This is a coverage hole created by the host move, not by any source change, and it is recorded here rather than absorbed into a skip count.

Now: 511/493/0/18 at ticket 267b (2026-09-06), measured natively with `cd apps/capability-host && npm ci && npm test` after packages/contracts was installed and built — the gate's own step order. FAILURE IDENTITY CHANGED, deliberately, and this is the last such change the list can carry: the final two permitted failures are FIXED and removed, and permittedFailures is now EMPTY. Both rows were no-direct-transport.arch.test.ts and both had one cause — SCANNED_ROOTS named five roots that exist in no repository under C:/Projects/Harborline/* (measured, git ls-files per repo: 0 hits for apps/carrier/, packages/ui-react/ and packages/ui-adapters-react/), so the per-root guard fired, and all 15 recorded (path, count) ratchet rows named files inside those absent roots. 267b pruned SCANNED_ROOTS to the one root that ships here (apps/capability-host/src, 47 scanned files) and rebuilt the ratchet from the real call sites in it — zero direct fetch call sites, so both SANCTIONED_FETCH and MIGRATION_DEBT are empty. The prune is recorded as a DECISION in the test file's own doc comment (what was pruned, why, on whose authority, and that the pruned trees live nowhere reachable), not as a cleanup. An empty exact-match ratchet is the STRICT state, not a weakened one: the first direct fetch() added under the scanned root fails it with no recorded row to hide behind, proven by mutation — a planted raw fetch turned it red before it was restored.

TOTAL 512 -> 511 is a net -1 from one test DELETED by that same rebuild, a deliberate removal rather than lost coverage: 'records a reason for every sanctioned transport' looped over SANCTIONED_FETCH, which is now empty, so it could never fail again. A permanently green test reads as coverage and is worse than none, so its assertion was folded into 'has exactly the recorded direct fetch call sites' — an assertion that CAN fail — where it re-arms the moment a sanctioned row comes back. Proven by mutation: a planted sanctioned row with a seven-character reason turns that test red.

PASSED 492 -> 493 reconciles exactly: 492 + the 2 formerly-failing tests that now pass - the 1 deleted test = 493. PENDING is unchanged at 18, the same darwin- and env-gated inventory recorded in skips.byFile; skips.coverageStatement stands unchanged.
